newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Mobil Singapore resumes work on aromatics plant.
newsitem.headline: Mobil Singapore resumes work on aromatics plant.

text.p: Mobil Singapore, a unit of Mobil Corp of the U.S., said it resumed maintenance work on Wednesday at its aromatics plant.

The work was suspended on Monday after a gas leak led to the death of one man and six injuries. A second workman died Wednesday morning as a result of the same accident, a spokesman for the National University Hospital said.
"Maintenance works on the aromatics complex resumed this afternoon with the exception of the specific area of the incident," Mobil said in a statement.
The 500,000-tonne-per-year petrochemical complex together with the company's 280,000-barrel-per-day refinery was shutdown for maintenance on March 15.
The maintenance is expected to last up to six weeks.
